messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy alert: wave-7 canary -> elevated 5xx on /v1/generate (us-east-1). 15% error rate, abort criteria hit. Paging oncall team.
alice_oncall: Ack. Paging. Joining channel, grabbing context.
ben_platform: I see the deploy wave-7 tag. Can we confirm which feature flag is driving traffic to the canary? 
maya_engineering: feature flag `model_v2_rollout` is on for 5% traffic to canary.
alice_oncall: Quick checks: k8s pod error rates, LB health, and any top logs. Can someone run `kubectl -n prod get pods -l roll=wave7-canary -o wide`?
ben_platform: Running now — pods are `wave7-canary-0..3` all `Running`, CPU low. But 2/4 pods show restarts.
sre_bot: Alert snippet: 2026-03-17T10:02:13Z route=/v1/generate status=5xx count=78 within 60s, p95 latency 420ms.
maya_engineering: tailing logs from pod wave7-canary-1: ```
ERROR HTTP/1.1 502 upstream read error: runtime: out of memory while processing batch
stack: ... transformer::kv cache
``` 
alice_oncall: OOMs in the canary — looks like quantized model under certain sequence lengths causing OOM. This is customer-impacting for canary traffic only but 5% of users.
prod-support: Any visible user errors or customer reports? No current tickets, but monitoring shows spike in downstream retries.
alice_oncall: Immediate mitigation plan: 1) flip `model_v2_rollout` flag off (cut traffic from canary), 2) scale down canary pods, 3) open a rollback if flag flip doesn't reduce 5xx. Who can flip flag now?
ben_platform: I can flip the flag via LaunchDarkly console, doing it now -> @here feature model_v2_rollout set to 0% for prod.
alice_oncall: After flip — monitoring? 
sre_bot: Telemetry: 90s after flag flip error rate on /v1/generate dropped to 1.8% in us-east-1. Latency stable.
maya_engineering: Confirmed logs: OOMs stop, restart spikes gone. Looks like disabling rollout removed problematic instances.
alice_oncall: Since abort criteria met we will not continue wave-7. Next steps: rollback the canary image from wave-7 to wave-6 in Deploy pipeline, and run a postmortem. Ben, can you kick off rollback? 
ben_platform: Starting rollback pipeline now (Jenkins job #deploy-rollback-wave7). ETA ~6m.
prod-support: Updating internal status page: "Deploy wave-7 canary paused due to 5xx; traffic routed back to stable. No broad customer impact detected. Monitoring continuing." 
alice_oncall: Handing off to oncall shadow for followup and postmortem: @maya_engineering will own the investigation into OOMs and quantization edge cases. I'll stay on incident to confirm rollback completes.
maya_engineering: Acknowledged. I'll collect heap profiles and tokenizer input shapes; adding hypothesis: certain long prompts trigger KV-cache growth combined with quantized kernels.
alice_oncall: Rollback completed, health metrics back to baseline. Closing active mitigation. Filing incident ticket and scheduling postmortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigation successful). Incident ID: INC-2026-0317-472."
